findings.reason: the follow-up is the stated hand-off a build node reads first, and it names the exact source §13 forbids, so implementations could diverge from the section without noticing.
findings.text: f-arolw-013's body still says the reservation is "keyed once on the attempt the ledger computes", while §13 (docs/plans/a-run-has-one-live-worker.html:165) now explicitly rejects the ledger as a key source and keys on the newest attempt receipt in the run directory; a node reading the hand-off before the section would key on ledger.runs or prior_node_runs[-1], the two sources §13 names as wrong, and could reintroduce the differing-keys defect the section exists to close

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the cited symbols and near-line anchors resolve: claim_next_attempt at resumption.py:398, _claim_may_be_reclaimed at resumption.py:366–386, prior_node_runs[-1] at dispatch.py:2737, attempt = int(previous_attempt)+1 at dispatch.py:2743, _create_worktree at dispatch.py:2834, the CLI-branch _prepare_attempt_records at dispatch.py:3438, admit_once at queue_admission.py:4810, and _retired_attempt_ended at dispatch_launch.py:2072.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §13 ¶"Done when" names fifteen cases, and its "Negative controls" sentence names a distinct logged control for each, including the fresh-run-id case added since the last review.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate output and every log sit under the run directory, each opening with its revision and literal command and closing in a bare EXIT= line.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test filename and §13's prose carry no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause reproduces in the code (_launch_refused_by at dispatch_launch.py:2138 reaches _retired_attempt_ended without reading the in-flight attempt.json), the receipt-based key recomputes deterministically because attempt receipts are written by _write_attempt_artifact at spawn and at exit (dispatch_launch.py:2247, 3331, 4165), and every door the mechanism relies on is named: dispatch.py:2534/2743/2834, resumption.py:1705, supervised_launch at dispatch_launch.py:2664, and admit_once at queue_admission.py:4810.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §13 carries one deliverable: a reservation that refuses a concurrent launch of one run id, with its freeing rules.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the hand-off followup f-arolw-013 (docs/plans/a-run-has-one-live-worker.html:243) still names the ledger as the key source that §13 rejects.
